summary.what_it_does: This is the news index for the Grok AI maker, with each entry a one-line announcement and date. Recent items cover Grok 4.5 and Grok 4.6 coding and agentic models, which are listed as available in GitHub Copilot, Amazon Bedrock, and Microsoft Foundry. It also lists Grok Bot, a persistent always-on agent product for teams and enterprises, and Grok Build, a terminal coding agent. Other entries include Grok add-ins for Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook, voice and speech models, and image and video generation models. Older entries trace the lineage from Grok-1 (2024 open weights) to Grok 4 (2025) and the Grok 4.1 rollout. The page itself is a list of headlines, so most details live in linked posts not included here.
notable: Chronological changelog spanning Nov 2023 to Sep 2026 covering model, agent, and API releases
Grok models distributed through GitHub Copilot, Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Foundry, and Databricks
Grok Bot and Grok Build agent products with team sharing and background work
Add-ins for Office apps and Google Workspace
caveats: Page is a headline list; the body of each announcement is not included
Several entries reference SuperGrok, Premium, and Enterprise subscription tiers, which are paid
The page names the company as SpaceXSI and mentions SpaceX's acquisition of xAI, so the branding is inconsistent
